SUN · EARTH · MOON TRIANGLE

Apparent geocentric Sun and Moon (same engine as the HUD). ψ = elongation at Earth, i = phase angle at the Moon (illuminated fraction = (1 + cos i)/2), δ = angle at the Sun. Time is shared with the HUD.

LUNAR PHYSICAL EPHEMERIS

The disk is a procedural model (major maria, bright and dark-floor craters, relief shading) — not a photograph. Tap the disk to read selenographic coordinates, nearest feature and Sun elevation. Geometry is exact: phase, libration (LLIB04 principal-axis frame), sub-solar point and axis position angle come from the engines in this file. Lommel–Seeliger shading; earthshine scales with Earth phase.

ASTRONOMICAL TRIANGLE PZX · 3D ON THE CELESTIAL SPHERE

SUN · MOON

Earth orientation, CIP/CIO, dX/dY, polar motion and sub-daily EOP come from the IAU 2006/2000A engine with IERS EOP tables and the FCN continuation of dX, dY. Time = device clock + manual offset (no network). Sun: IPS2000 Earth-Moon barycentre (Chapront & Francou 2002; ≤ 0.011″ vs DE406 in longitude, 500–2500) corrected for the lunar offset (JANUS) and aberration, IAU 2006 frame; outside 500–2500 a low-precision series (≈0.01°) is used, Moon: JANUS 98.12 / ELP 2000-85 (1324 terms), apparent geocentric, formal uncertainty 0.5″ + 0.75″·|t| in longitude (t in Julian centuries from J2000); nutation IAU 2006/2000A_R06 (IERS Conventions 2010, Tables 5.3a/b), stars: bright subset, approximate J2000 values (≈0.1°) precessed to date. Distances: R = 6371.0088 km; Vincenty: WGS-84. Tap a marker or the globe for its data card.

LUNAR LIBRATION · SHADOW AXIS (LIVE)

Libration: Chapront, Chapront-Touzé & Francou LLIB04 (JCGF 0407) + numerical complements, rotated with the IAU 2006/2000A frame and JANUS lunar ephemeris. l, b = sub-Earth point in the principal-axis frame. Shadow axis = Moon→Sun line, γ in Earth radii; γ < 1 + l1 means the penumbra touches the Earth.

SYZYGIES · PERIGEE/APOGEE · ECLIPSES

Besselian elements from the same apparent geocentric Sun/Moon vectors (k = 0.272488 / 0.272281, shadow enlargement 1% as NASA/Espenak). Times are UTC and TD (TT).
